your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Reject. p1 holds St James+Tennessee; NY completes orange. After paying $400 they still have ~$686 and can mortgage to build (2 houses each = $200-220 rent immediately). $400 cannot offset a buildable orange monopoly. Keep States (blocks p3 pink), Indiana (red block, KY unowned), Marvin (blocks p2 yellow). Cash $416 stays liquid for Atlantic/Oriental/KY. Never trade NY.

Owe p2 $450 on PA (2 houses); cash $416, short $34. Any mortgage covers it and I keep ownership, so all four still block monopolies. Mortgage Marvin ($140) for the biggest buffer: $416-$450+$140=$106. That absorbs utility/rail/base rents. States/NY/Indiana yield only $36-$76 and force another liquidation on the next small hit. Do not bankrupt. Never trade NY (p1 orange), States (p3 pink), Indiana (red), or Marvin (p2 yellow). Cannot survive Boardwalk 3 houses ($1400) even if I mortgage everything.

Cash $106. Death rolls are Park Place ($600) and Boardwalk ($1400); mortgaging States/NY/Indiana only raises $280, still short, and I can mortgage at payment time. No +EV trade: NY completes p1 orange and they will build; States completes p3 pink; Indiana/Marvin don't finish sets and won't buy survival cash. Keep all blockers. End turn and hope to pass GO.

Cash $306 is survival, not a $60 dead brown. p2 owns Mediterranean; brown monopoly is weak and they only have $166, so even-build is at most 1 house each ($20 rent) and drains the green threat. Roll of 3 from here is Oriental ($100) which completes p1 light blue — must stay liquid to deny it. $306 also covers income tax ($200) and still reaches Kentucky ($220)/Atlantic ($260); $246 does not reach Atlantic. Cannot complete brown myself. Auction: best if p1 overpays, acceptable if p2 gets it cheap. Never trade NY/States/Indiana/Marvin.

Drop. $306 must stay liquid: roll 2 is Income Tax $200, roll 4 is Oriental $100 (deny p1 light blue). $62 Baltic leaves me short of Atlantic and tight after tax. I cannot complete brown. p2 winning at $61 is fine — monopoly is weak, drains their $166, and they cannot even-build meaningfully. p1 can still overpay; I will not be the one stuck with it. Never trade NY/States/Indiana/Marvin.

Never trade NY/States/Indiana/Marvin. Next must-buy is only Oriental if it would complete p1 light blue.
